lines.text: After school.
I gather my work and head to the library.
*Slide*
Huh?
Arcana's designated seat by the window is empty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is that you?
Arcana? Are you back there?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, I'm in the stacks behind the counter.
I put my bag down and head toward the door where Arcana's voice is coming from.
*Click*
*Cough, cough* Yikes.
What's with all the dust?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, you didn't have to come in.
Arcana comes out carrying an armful of old books.
What are all those?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Before I answer, let's get out of this dust trap first.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Chop-chop.
Err, yeah, okay.
Arcana pushes my back and we both exit out the door.
*Click*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Phew...
Arcana puts the books down on the desk.
So, what are those?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right. They're meeting minutes.
Meeting minutes?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep.
Arcana opens one of the books.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: They don't do this much anymore,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but long ago, they used to keep physical copies of documents in books like this, in addition to having electronic copies.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So I got to thinking that maybe there'd be something about past festivals in here. Y'know, for reference.
I didn't even know this kind of thing existed.
Wouldn't it be hard to go through everything, though?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's exactly why I became a library committee member.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: To throw out what needs to be thrown out, and to organize what needs organizing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: At this point, I'm almost done.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I paced myself so that I'm pretty sure I'll be able to finish before the festival starts.
But that was before you decided to join the executive committee, no?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: T-technically, yes...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It'll be fine, though. I'll just have to work a little harder.
Arcana dusts off her uniform, then goes over to a window and opens it.
A spring breeze pours into the library together with a twilight glow.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ahhh, that's so refreshing.
Yeah...
Arcana tucks her hair behind her ear and looks at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're going to be even busier moving forward, huh?
Yeah... I'm already starting to feel overwhelmed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'll help you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm going to be on the executive committee, after all.
Hmm...
I reflexively start to say she doesn't need to,
but then I remember what she said before.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to be someone you can rely on too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've been there for me as a commander, and now as a teacher...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to give you as much strength as you've given me. More, even.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Whether you're my teacher, or my commander...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want to be someone you can lean on.
... Thank you. Let's do this.
Arcana holds out her pinky finger.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Promise?
Yeah. Promise.
I hook my pinky finger with hers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: When this is all over, we're going to do everything you want.
Are you sure you can handle that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Er, uh...
Arcana seems slightly flustered.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Th-then let's make one more promise.
Sure, what?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Be gentle and loving.
Er, uh...
We look at each other in silence for a moment, then burst out laughing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft. What even is this conversation we're having?
Seriously, haha. You came on so strong, and then kinda fizzled out...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm still not fully prepared, okay?
Arcana rests her hand on the window frame with a gentle smile,
and then turns her head to look outside.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know... I'm not someone who's, like,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: super strong-willed, or motivated by some overwhelming sense of duty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't really like working, or even going into work,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and I'm easily shaken when confronted by temptation... Really, I'm just a normal person.
Arcana looks back at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's why I'm grateful to you, for keeping me steady.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thank you.
Arcana's words make me recall everything that's happened between us at the school.
There were definitely some close calls.
If I'd made a different choice then,
our time at this school would probably have gone very differently.
Don't shortchange yourself, Arcana. You've been doing great.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Heh, you think so?
Arcana stands up and walks toward me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We've both been giving it our best, haven't we?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Me as a student, you as a teacher.
That's right.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then wouldn't you say...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: that for whatever time we've got left,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: we deserve a little reward?
What kind of reward did you have in mind?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well... Let's see.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We could eat alone, just the two of us...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Or we could stealthily shoot each other looks during class...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Or maybe even have a secret relationship?
Even though we're still teacher and student?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Even though we're still teacher and student.
Arcana smiles playfully.
You didn't even consider the possibility that I would say no, did you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like they say, telling someone how you feel isn't a gamble—it's a confirmation.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And right now, I'm one hundred percent certain.
... I couldn't say no to you even if I wanted to.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So that means today's our first day together, right?
... Yeah, I guess it does.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Woohoo!
After an over-the-top celebration, Arcana takes a step closer to me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We're going to have to work twice as hard from here on,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: now that we have to balance our jobs and our relationship.
We have to be careful not to get caught.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's more exciting when you let it show just a little, though, isn't it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And anyway, usually it's only the couple that thinks they're hiding anything.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Meanwhile, everyone around them knows.
Really...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course. It's impossible to completely hide it.
Arcana looks up at me.
... She looks unmistakably like a girl in love.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: See? It's all over your face.
She gently brushes my cheek with her fingertips.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Everything's written right here...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So much so that, despite never having dated anyone or even held a guy's hand,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I could still tell for certain. One hundred percent.
I cup Arcana's cheeks in return.
It's the same with you, Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. It's that obvious?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Still... there's definitely a line we shouldn't cross, right?
Yeah, that would be... too much...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The moment we cross it, I wouldn't be able to hold back.
... That's the issue for you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. Once I break, all bets are off.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's why I try to never break from my routine without a really good reason.
I see...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That being said, while being platonic is nice and all...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want for us to at least kiss...
Er...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Argh, screw it.
Huh?!
Arcana pushes me back and looks up at me as she plants her hand on the wall.
... What, did you decide to just not hold back? What about your routine?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I thought about it, and it's so unfair.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why should I have to hold back? You're the teacher, right? Shouldn't that be your job?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So I'll tell you what. I'm not going to hold back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You can be the one to step on the brakes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You'd better hurry! If you don't break now, we'll get into an accident...
... Time-out.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you... Mmph?!
Arcana's eyes widen, then slowly close.
Her pale hands arc through the air for a brief moment,
before resting gently on my chest.
Slowly, I pull my lips away.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Aw...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No fair...
What?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "Time-out" is supposed to be my thing.
I don't remember that being a rule.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, it is! I just made it one!
Now you just sound like a child.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmph. What else would you expect?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm a schoolgirl who just had her first kiss!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... You really shouldn't do that anymore.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm serious, too. I'll only end up acting more spoiled if you do.
No, I don't think you will.
I trust you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Seriously now... That's just mean.
I look at Arcana's face right in front of me.
Everything she's feeling is written all over it.
You're embarrassed, aren't you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course I'm embarrassed...
Heheh.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't laugh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm trying to set the mood.
Sorry, sorry.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Never mind. Time-out.
Another one, huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's your fault.
Arcana mutters in a sulky voice and lets out a small sigh.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know... Hm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Ugh, I give up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There's so much I want to say that I can't organize my thoughts.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just... wanna do this.
Do wha... Mmph?!
True to her word, Arcana seems to have decided not to hold back.
Which, you know... should be fine.
Contrary to what she may have said,
Arcana has a stronger sense of duty and responsibility than anyone I know...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So if kissing is okay, that means holding hands and hugging are fair game, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like, if you think of it as a spectrum, they come before kissing, don't they?
Duty... and responsibility...
I thought you were trying to set the mood.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I was, but now I'm feeling self-conscious.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And besides...
Arcana leans against me and grins.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Doesn't this feel more like... us?
Yeah... It does.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's stay like this for just a little longer...
How much longer?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Until you hit the brakes.
2x2 Love: Arcana - True Ending (2)
